text: Lack of transparency regarding AUTO-RENEWAL and NO GRACE PERIOD for Certificates of Deposit by Pentagon Federal Credit Union ( PENFED ). I was not told verbally or in writing when I opened a very large CD ( opened XX/XX/XXXX, matures XX/XX/XXXX ) that PENFED has no grace period and that an online auto-renew switch must be turned off by the customer to stop a CD from renewing immediately at maturity. An online auto-renew switch is not a legally binding document and is susceptible to technical glitches and errors. I mailed PENFED a certified letter instructing them not to renew my CD at maturity and to provide me with a written document reflecting my request. A review from a dissatisfied PENFED customer and a XXXX article alerted me to what appears to be PENFEDs attempt to cause unsuspecting CD holders to unintentionally renew a CD and then be on the hook for early withdrawal fees.
